product_one_liner.value: Formalize is a governance, risk and compliance platform that helps compliance, information-security and privacy professionals automate regulatory workflows, manage risks and controls, and organize policies, audits and evidence.

pricing_page.notes: Public plans and a free trial are described; paid pricing is tailored rather than listed as a fixed amount.

employee_band.notes: The company describes a team of 200+ professionals; the available company profile reports 240 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog is compliance and regulatory content, not an engineering-authored blog about building the product.

public_docs.notes: Public guides cover workflows, questionnaires, incidents, reports, approvals, the Audit module and Formalize IQ.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board has eight roles, none with a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title; AI tooling in an engineering job does not qualify.

model_provider.notes: No underlying model or model provider was identified in the reviewed public product help, AI FAQ/blog, AI terms, security or privacy materials. The client policy directs readers to the Trust Center for the DPA subprocessor list, but that list could not be read publicly. AWS Frankfurt hosting does not establish a model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Formalize explicitly claims ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification. SOC 2 references concern AWS facilities, not a Formalize attestation; GDPR processor obligations and PCI DSS scanning criteria are not company certifications.

last_funding.notes: Announced October 28, 2025. Formalize reports €30 million; the cited funding record reports the USD equivalent as $35 million, rather than a USD-denominated company announcement.

raised_18mo.notes: The October 28, 2025 Series B falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Sales Development Representative – Norway opening.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 12, 2026 announcement introduces a new Audit module; Formalize IQ was also announced October 7, 2026. Both fall within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Kasper Mathias Svendsen joined Formalize in May 2026 and his profile lists VP of Product from September 2026, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting explicitly identifies HubSpot as the CRM and requires logging customer interactions in it.
